calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Jobleads
calls.summary: Job Leads is refining its experimentation strategy under Edd Saunders, the new Product Experimentation Manager, by centralizing management to improve visibility and governance. Current analytics are hindered by a backlog of over 100 tickets with the BI team, but integrating GrowthBook is expected to provide quicker self-service data access, enhancing experimentation velocity and decision quality. Job Leads has conducted around 50 experiments over two years, averaging less than two per month, with successful tests yielding up to 15% lifts. Edd will initially manage GrowthBook, fostering a power user model for enhanced experimentation capacity. A follow-up demo focused on advanced analytics and a proof of concept is planned to solidify internal buy-in.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, GrowthBook, Data Warehouse, Feature Flags, Product Analytics, BI Bottleneck
